performance.cpuSamplingScope: CPU sample bound with source-map attribution; does not measure OS stalls or prove absence of every possible long task

limitations: Enhanced recording needs HTTPS or localhost
Single event 512KiB, capture 10MiB/5min/10000 events; large responses are explicitly ineligible
Synthetic strings do not reproduce arbitrary original-text or pixel-level defects
CPU sampling is observed evidence, not a universal guarantee across machines
